Renamed 41 of 44 PDFs to `YYYY-MM-DD_vendor.pdf`. I haven't spot-checked the vendor names the tool extracted, so skim the new filenames for any misparsed ones.

Three files were left unchanged because they're image-only scans with no text layer, so no date could be read: `scan_0012.pdf`, `scan_0013.pdf`, `IMG_2231.pdf`.

To rename them, I'd need OCR or you could give me the date and vendor for each. Tell me which you prefer.
